purpose: prospective source-held-out evaluation of source-domain pretraining and target-domain transfer for microseismic localization
interpretation_scope: Twelve noise-free synthetic source locations on the same Overthrust velocity model and receiver layout. This tests new source positions, not new geology or field data. FMM uses first-arrival picks and the known heterogeneous velocity; learned models use full receiver traces plus the same FMM-arrival constraint.
